operating_book.rationale: Reuse the finite operating-company P/B screen while normalized cash flows and capital claims are not underwritten; not a peer study or FCFF result.

layered_book.rationale: Reuse the finite holding and asset-company P/B screen; not appraised NAV, proven-resource value, or completed SOTP.

TBGI.route_reason: Connectivity operating economics require FCFF; parent book value is a separate screen.
TBGI.intrinsic_blocker: Spectrum and license life, recurring cash flows, network capex, funding and terminal reinvestment are not reconciled.
TBGI.source_warning: PSE-reported EPS rounds to zero; the book screen is not a cash-flow forecast.

IS.route_reason: An operating cash-flow model would require a supportable going-concern and capital bridge.
IS.intrinsic_blocker: Negative equity, persistent losses and a large current-liability excess leave ordinary-common residual and financing unresolved; positive P/B cannot be applied.
IS.source_warning: July fiscal interim is retained; zero parent fields are unavailable attribution, not zero economic claims.

PHC.route_reason: Telecom interests and investments require attributable SOTP; parent book is a separate screen.
PHC.intrinsic_blocker: Investment values, ownership, cash realization and subsidiary claims are not reconciled.
PHC.source_warning: Only 60 million of 996.4 million outstanding common shares appear as listed on the PSE stock page; the screen divides by all outstanding shares, not only listed shares.

LODE.route_reason: Investment assets require attributable SOTP; total book per common share is only a tentative screen.
LODE.intrinsic_blocker: Asset realizable value, ownership and parent-only claims are not established; zero revenue provides no operating cash-flow basis.
LODE.source_warning: The interim summary prints PHP0.80 BVPS, but PHP225.37m total equity / 3bn shares is PHP0.0751. This screen uses the arithmetic total-book proxy, not the unreconciled printed figure; parent attribution remains unresolved.

CPM.route_reason: Distinct mineral and industrial assets require finite-life attributable SOTP; parent book is a separate screen.
CPM.intrinsic_blocker: Reserve life, project economics, debt, funding and restoration claims are not reconciled.
CPM.source_warning: FY2025 and 1H2026 losses accompany a material decline in parent equity; the PSE's whole-peso BVPS display is too coarse for this screen.

APL.route_reason: Project rights require finite-life asset economics; parent book is only a separate screen.
APL.intrinsic_blocker: No reported revenue in FY2025 or 1H2026; reserve rights, extraction economics, funding and dilution are not underwritten.
APL.source_warning: The P/B range is a speculative asset-book screen, not a proven mineral reserve value or funded project forecast.

ABA.route_reason: Property and investment interests require attributable SOTP; parent equity per common share is a separate screen.
ABA.intrinsic_blocker: Asset marks, realization, minority claims, debt and non-listed common-share rights are not fully reconciled.
ABA.source_warning: PSE total equity PHP23.57bn greatly exceeds parent equity PHP6.17bn; reported PHP3.06 BVPS is not substituted for parent equity / 4.50bn outstanding shares. Listed shares are fewer than outstanding.

PAX.route_reason: Investment holdings and the BPO subsidiary require attributable SOTP.
PAX.intrinsic_blocker: Reported interim BVPS PHP5.97 does not reconcile to parent equity PHP1.265bn / 1.149bn reported outstanding common shares; treasury or other ownership rights and operating income require review.
PAX.source_warning: The total-equity and parent-equity bases diverge materially; no P/B result is published until the share bridge is understood.

LMG.route_reason: Current investment assets and any resumed operations need source-specific valuation; parent book is a separate screen.
LMG.intrinsic_blocker: No reported gross revenue in FY2025 or 1H2026; investment income, asset liquidity and future operations are not underwritten.
LMG.source_warning: The PSE company description of chemicals is not evidence of current operating sales; this is an asset-book screen only.

extra_sources.label: PRIM Series A preferred conversion notice

PRIM.route_reason: The media joint venture and parent capital structure require attributable SOTP.
PRIM.intrinsic_blocker: Series A convertible preferred conversion and resulting common dilution are unresolved; total equity cannot be assigned to present ordinary common holders.
PRIM.source_warning: Reported PHP0.51 BVPS reflects total equity; listed and outstanding common shares differ, and 1H2026 revenue is negligible.
